scope: Inspect a finite query-dependent native-state partition source, not admit a 405B core.
obligations: O4 explicit index and selection accounting
native_abi: binary32 words passed through the pinned libm fmaf wrapper; round-to-nearest; fixed serial column order; no floating-point flags in the observed interface
reject_universal_core_if: A legal family retains all mn bucket FMAs or selection/index cost exceeds the budget; no timing optimization after that conclusion.
known_before_execution: The partition algorithm has an O(n*m*m*ceil(m/64)) bitmap-selection upper bound and an O(n*m*ceil(m/64)) indexed-word storage upper bound. No universal 10x or target-budget theorem is available.
purpose_of_reference: Make the examined source constructor, selector, native transition and costs executable rather than leave a perfect selector as an undefined subroutine.
